text:
olivia: Short update — GAing HorizonRT Incremental (rt-inc-small/medium) and Smart Failover on hosted today. New additive streaming endpoint /v1/realtime/stream-inc. :tada:

rahul: Cool. Any immediate action for teams?

olivia: Smoke tests recommended. Smart Failover is enabled by default for new orgs but can be toggled per-route in Console or via header x-rw-routing-policy: "no-fallback".

devex: Quick curl example:

```
curl -N -H "Authorization: Bearer $RW_KEY" \
  -H "x-rw-routing-policy: prefer-latency" \
  -d '{"model":"rt-inc-medium","input":"ping"}' \
  https://api.redwood.ai/v1/realtime/stream-inc
```

deploy-bot: deploy 1901.23 started by olivia — canary 7% us-central-1. Dashboard: https://deploy.redwood.ai/1901.23

eng-oncall: Oncall will monitor canary for 72h. Alert if p95 regressions >25% or error-rate >2x baseline.

product: We’ll publish the external release note after canary checks. CS and Marketing looped in.

rahul: I'll flip our demo to rt-inc-small and report any anomalies to the rollout board.

olivia: Thanks — please tag eng-oncall on any regressions. Appreciate quick smoke tests. :rocket:
